_readme: Field model for FLL Mission Control. All units are INCHES. Grid is 1 in x 1 in. Origin (0,0) = bottom-left corner of the mat as seen from the team's launch side. +x = right along the long edge, +y = up toward the far wall. Heading: 0 deg = facing +y, positive = clockwise (90 = facing +x). Edit polygons by clicking points in the dashboard; it writes back to this file.

mat.note: Standard FLL mat is about 93 x 45 in. Measure your printed mat and correct these if different.

center_offset_in.note: distance from wheel axle to the point we track as the robot's position

robot.note: TODO: measure your robot and fill these in. Wheel diameter 56 mm = standard SPIKE Prime wheel.

alignment_features.note: Walls and black lines the robot can square against or detect to correct its position.

missions.name: EXAMPLE - delete me
missions.notes: Polygon = the model's footprint on the mat. Approach = where the robot should be (and which way it should face) right before it does the mission.

obstacles.note: Anything the robot must drive around that isn't a mission model.

runs.notes: A run = one launch from home. Waypoints are clicked in the dashboard and turned into drive()/turn() calls.
